about: Judge calibration (PLAN §18, D15): claim / cited-text pairs from the 4b-1b quick runs (synthetic meetings), labeled by hand. Labels: yes = every fact in the claim is in the cited text; partial = the main point is, a detail isn't, nothing contradicts; no = the main point isn't there or a detail contradicts it. Constructed pairs change one thing in a real claim or its citation (see `source`).
